newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends touch firmer after reversal.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends touch firmer after reversal.

text.p: COMEX copper ended slightly firmer, clambering back on to firmer territory after being down most of the session as it tested a key technical support level to fill gaps in the charts, traders said.
There appeared to be no fresh fundamental news behind the reversal.
LME three months broke through recent lows to reach $2,305 a tonne, but good trade support on LME and COMEX came in to push the market back up, William O'Neill of Merrill Lynch said.
"The jury is still out - the market needs to follow through tomorrow," O'Neill said.
May COMEX settled 0.05 cent firmer at 108.80 cents a lb, traded 109.50 to 106.90 cents. Spot March went out 0.40 cent higher at 112.90 cents.
Volume was relatively good at an estimated 13,000 lots compared to Tuesday's official 8,041 lots.
COMEX stocks on Wednesday rose 1,379 short tons to 36,571 short tons.
